blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Panorama Ridge
What trades here

items.t: What the ground is: Detached houses are the South Newton plan area's base residential form, and most housing here is fee-simple detached. The ridge lots are the product; there is no new bare-land subdivision feeding the market.

Fee-simple is the default lot form; no bare-land strata verified: Strata product in the sub-area is townhouse/condo strata under the Strata Property Act — not bare-land strata. Tenure is read lot by lot on title.

Lot character — zone minimum: South Newton lands are zoned under Surrey Zoning Bylaw No. 12000 (R-series residential, with RA at the rural edges toward Colebrook); the research records an R3 minimum subdivision lot area of 660 m² at Part 26 Section F of the bylaw for this plan area. That figure is carried exactly — the parcel's own zone section governs, so confirm the specific lot's zone and section with the City before relying on the number.

Creek ground is part of the lot fabric: South Newton is home to fish-bearing creeks — Archibald Creek headwaters, Sullivan Heights Creek and several tributaries of Hyland Creek — so riparian setback rules can apply to creek-side lots and can limit the building envelope. This is a land fact, not a house fact: it survives a teardown.
ALR vs non-ALR: ALR land inside this sub-area: Not verified — no ALR split is asserted. The Serpentine lowlands lie south of Highway 10. Check any Colebrook-edge parcel on the ALC maps.

Serviced vs unserviced — the Colebrook edge is the open question: Per-lot servicing (septic vs community services) at the Colebrook Road edge: Not verified. Do not assume community water/sewer at the rural edges; properties not connected to community water and sewer are also an SSMUH exemption category. Confirm servicing for the specific lot with the City.

Not land stock — townhouse ground, cross-reference only: Nora (12830 62 Ave, 42 townhouses, 2022), Steller Panorama (5858 132 St, 39 townhouses, 2022) and The Uplands (15152 62A Ave, 124 townhouses, 2005) sit on Panorama Ridge ground but are built strata complexes. Their lots are not severable land inventory and are not re-documented here as land.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Panorama Ridge

items.t: Panorama Ridge is in the City of Surrey, in the South Newton plan area of the Newton community — the City describes South Newton as a large neighbourhood in the southeast of the broader Newton community. No stand-alone City boundary for "Panorama Ridge" is published: Not verified as an official line. The South Newton plan area that contains it covers lands generally north of Highway 10, east of King George Boulevard and west of 152 Street, an area of about 485 hectares.
MLS sub-area name: "Panorama Ridge" is a Surrey sub-area name in the SnapStats Surrey community set (September 2026, SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).
Commercial nodes the City names for South Newton: Panorama Heights at 152 Street and Highway 10, and Sullivan Heights at 64 Avenue and 144 Street.
Nearby areas: Sullivan Station to the north, East Newton to the northwest, West Newton to the west, and the Serpentine lowlands and Delta to the south across Highway 10.
Search and alternate names: "Panorama Ridge," "Sullivan" / "Sullivan Heights," "South Newton," and "Panorama Heights" (the 152 St / Hwy 10 commercial node).

Corridors relevant to land: King George Boulevard north to Surrey Central; Highway 10 east to Langley/Cloverdale and west toward Delta; 152 Street and 64 Avenue are the other main corridors. Transit on the grid: routes 321, 322 and 324, with the R1 RapidBus on King George Boulevard west of the area; route-level confirmation for the Panorama Drive loop itself: Not verified against a TransLink timetable.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Panorama Ridge

items.t: Riparian / creek diligence (the Panorama Ridge land item): Archibald Creek headwaters, Sullivan Heights Creek and Hyland Creek tributaries run through the plan area; riparian/setback requirements and any development permit areas can limit building envelopes on creek-side lots — check City mapping and the lot's permit areas before valuing an addition, rebuild or subdivision.

Slope / south-edge diligence: The research documents the ridge form, Highway 10 at the south edge and the lowlands beyond it: check highway noise exposure and confirm the lot is on the upland side of the floodplain picture before subjects. A parcel-level geotechnical report requirement for a specific Panorama Ridge lot: Not confirmed — obtain the City's requirements for the parcel rather than assuming a slope study is or is not required.

ALR rules (only where a parcel is confirmed ALR — none confirmed in-area): Residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; principal residence ≤500 m², suite within the principal residence only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).

BC Assessment farm class — full three-tier form: $2,500 (0.8–4 ha); $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area over 4 ha (>4 ha); $10,000 (<0.8 ha); application on or before October 31. A flat "$2,500+" statement is an error pattern and is not used here.
Health-care anchor for the area: No hospital is inside the sub-area; the Surrey-Newton Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 6830 King George Boulevard, Surrey.

blocks.text: Good to know about Panorama Ridge

items.t: The governing plan changed underneath this neighbourhood in 2026. The South Newton plan was rescinded by the Surrey 2050 OCP update, after a December 2, 2024 Council endorsement of updated land-use designations for the area — land priced on the old plan needs re-pricing against Bylaw 21900 and Bylaw 12000.
The City parks directory lists Sullivan-area parks on the ridge and Colebrook Park lands along Colebrook Road, with Newton Athletic Park (7395 128 St) the major sports park west of the area.
The guide research's "Sellers Best Bet" label could not be re-read.
A school physically on your street is not necessarily your catchment school.

faq.q: Is there a vacant lot I can buy on the ridge?
faq.a: No bare-land subdivision is verified — the purchase is an existing fee-simple house lot for rebuild/added units.

faq.q: How much of my creek-side lot can I actually build on?
faq.a: Riparian setbacks for Archibald Creek headwaters, Sullivan Heights Creek and Hyland Creek tributaries can limit the envelope — get the City's watercourse mapping and permit-area check for the parcel before valuing a rebuild.

faq.q: Is a Colebrook-edge lot on sewer and water?
faq.a: Not verified per lot — and unconnected properties are an SSMUH exemption category. Confirm with the City before counting added units.

faq.q: How many units can the lot hold?
faq.a: 3 under 280 m², 4 over 280 m², up to 6 on eligible 281 m²+ lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop — subject to zone, servicing and any creek/permit-area limits.

faq.q: What is the minimum lot I can subdivide to?
faq.a: The research records an R3 minimum subdivision lot area of 660 m² for this plan area (Bylaw 12000, Part 26 Section F) — confirm the parcel's own zone section with the City.

faq.q: Which schools are in Panorama Ridge?
faq.a: Panorama Ridge Secondary (13220 64 Ave) and Colebrook Elementary (5404 125a St) are in the area, with McLeod Road Traditional (6325 142 St) also serving it; catchments are by address via the SD36 School Locator.

faq.q: What governs land use here now?
faq.a: The South Newton NCP was rescinded by the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan update, so the OCP and Zoning Bylaw 12000 govern; a lot's zoning can be checked in City mapping.
